subject: website
name: IPLD
summary: The IPLD website, open source (Apache-2.0 or MIT). Its only third-party code is a YouTube player visible on the page, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: the player and Google Fonts load from Google when the page opens.

connections.name: YouTube embed (www.youtube.com)
connections.note: A visible player on the page, loaded when it opens.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
